settings.text: WYX Golf Supply started with a simple idea: premium gear shouldn't come with a pro-shop markup. We hand-pick and quality-check every club, ball, and accessory so you can play your best round with confidence.

settings.heading: Performance you can trust
settings.text: From tee to green, every product we carry is chosen for performance and durability. If it doesn't make the cut for our own bags, it doesn't make it to the shelf.

settings.question: How long does shipping take?
settings.answer: Orders ship within 1-2 business days. Standard delivery arrives in 3-5 business days, with free shipping on orders over $99.

settings.question: What's your return policy?
settings.answer: We offer 30-day hassle-free returns on unused items in original packaging.
